name: Seven Mitochondria Instance Segmentation Datasets
description: A suite of seven instance segmentation datasets (six volume EM and one TEM) for evaluating mitochondria segmentation methods.
reputation: A well-known EM/tomography collection in the bioimage community (EMPIAR) used for benchmarking mitochondria segmentation methods.
notes: Biomedical imaging benchmark with seven datasets varying in modality and volume size; annotation quality and dataset heterogeneity can affect generalization; non-LLM benchmark and some volumes are relatively small which can limit large-scale training.
